notes.title: Major Update - v1.0.6
notes.content:
[h2]DYNAMIC ATMOSPHERE:[/h2]
[list]
[*] The dynamic events you can experience while playing The Nefargad have been improved.
[*] The probabilities of dynamic events have been adjusted.
[*] Increased the accuracy of dynamic fog.
[*] Bloom setting improved.
[/list]

[h2]EASTER EGGS:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Some easter eggs have been updated. We are waiting for you to find and share now. :)
[/list]

[h2]OTHER:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Torch lighting animation has been adjusted.
[*] Edited a typo in an English note.
[*] "Muzik Sesi" text in the menu has been updated to "Müzik Sesi".
[*] The lighting of movable objects used in solution of puzzles has been improved.
[*] Improved player movement experience in some puzzles.
[*] Improved camera movement in a puzzle.
[*] Some door sounds have been updated.
[*] Improved the solution of a puzzle.
[*] Adjusted the flame sounds in a puzzle.
[/list]

notes.title: Major Update - v1.0.5
notes.content:
[h1]ACHIEVEMENTS:[/h1]
[list]
[*] The Nefargad now has achievements! You will now receive achievements after certain actions.
[/list]

[h1]NOTES OVERHAUL:[/h1]
[list]
[*] All notes have been revised. They have been shortened as much as possible and their readability has been improved.
[*] In the notes, there will be a star symbol at the beginning of the paragraphs explaining the puzzle solutions. There will be no signs in the paragraphs that provide information about the story. This way, you can read the parts you want without reading the entire note.
[/list]

[h1]OTHER:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Some easter eggs have been updated.
[*] Dynamic fog atmosphere has been strengthened.
[*] Improved the rotation animation when the player's camera is forced to rotate in some directions.
[*] The informational text at the beginning of the dungeon has been updated. We recommend that our new players read it.
[/list]

notes.title: Minor Update - v1.0.4
notes.content:
After the feedback we received from our players:

[list]
[*] A general information screen has been added to the beginning of the dungeon.
[*] Player's walking speed has been increased.
[*] The walking speed of other things has also been increased. :)
[*] The credit screen at the end of the game has been updated.
[*] Dynamic atmosphere has been improved in some areas.
[*] Updated some movable objects.
[/list]

notes.title: Minor Update - v1.0.3
notes.content:
After the feedback we received from our players:

[list]
[*] Updated alternative solutions to some puzzles.
[*] Added in-game hint system. The system will give hints about the general gameplay of the game every 15 minutes.
[*] Updated some door/stone block sounds.
[*] Dynamic fog system updated. Ensured fog dynamically adapts to surrounding light sources.
[*] Adjustments were made to some moveable objects.
[/list]

notes.title: Minor Update
notes.content:
After the feedback we received from our players:

* Sentences that would cause confusion were edited in some in-notes.
* Improvements have been made to increase the player experience.
* The volume of the music at the end of the game has been reduced.
* Improvements have been made to the dynamic torch system.

notes.title: Minor Update
notes.content: Added dynamic particles for the menu.
